paragraphs.text:
The verdict of the Canadian authorities counts in your favor, 
but the parents of your students rise up in arms and force a 
thorough review of your case. They impute that you are an 
incompetent crank willing to risk innocent lives to pursue off-
the-wall theories. Your standing in the scientific community 
is imperiled.

You stand on your record. Make an Anthropology roll: if you succeed, 
go to 418; if you fail, go to 214.
